cc:Work.dc:description: Separate ideal-gas example at cooled endpoints 300 K. 5 kNs impulse at constant effective exhaust velocity 500 m/s consumes 10 kg air. Tank 43.05 L holds 5 kg at 10 MPa and 15 kg at 30 MPa absolute. Ambient inlet 0.1 MPa; reversible isothermal refill work 4.523 MJ. Electrical input at assumed 65% overall efficiency is 6.958 MJ or 1.933 kWh, requiring 347.916 s at 20 kW. This is not a real fast-fill trajectory or a high-pressure vessel design; pressure alone cannot establish recovered gas mass or readiness.
